name: heads-up
description: A popup at the top right and a boxed notice above the prompt when Claude is waiting on you, a tool call fails or a long turn finishes

show.title: Show as
show.description: popup: a small box over the top right corner for a few seconds. box: a notice above the prompt that stays until dismissed or your next prompt. both: the popup, and the box as the record of it

side.title: Side
side.description: Which edge of the band above the prompt the box sits against; the popup is always at the top right

turnAfter.title: Turn finished after
turnAfter.description: How long a turn has to run before its end is worth a notice: always notes every turn, never notes none
